name: Session Orchestration
description: Coordinate parallel Claude Code sessions for complex features. Alpha plans the effort and assigns tasks. Beta and Gamma build in separate terminals. Delta verifies. Each session reads its task from a shared coordination file — no copy-pasting prompts between terminals. Keeps the human close to the effort during vibe coding. Alpha remains free during the build for brainstorming, research, questions, pivots, and architectural code reviews. Built-in wrap-up flow updates CLAUDE.md at the close of each effort so future sessions start with accurate context.
longDescription:
Ships **5 skills**.

- **Skills** (5): `alpha` (Alpha — the brain session of a multi-session orchestrated effort), `beta` (Beta — a builder session in a multi-session orchestrated effort), `delta` (Delta — the mechanical verification gate of a multi-session orchestrated effort), `gamma` (Gamma — a builder session in a multi-session orchestrated effort), `polish` (Polish — applies the polish items Alpha wrote into this session's coordination-file section after design review)

Installs with `claude plugin install session-orchestration@claude-community` from `alphonso77/claude-orchestration`.
